props.name: Rojina Shakya

props.heading: A bridal morning, hour by hour
props.intro: For a 10:00 ceremony we start at five. Anita has done this more than two hundred times, and she still arrives with a checklist.

image.alt: A bride in a red and gold veil and heavy gold jewellery

items.title: Skin first
items.text: A cleanse and a cold compress while the chiya is poured. Skin that is calm holds make-up through a long day of tika and photographs.

items.title: Hair and the bun
items.text: Set, backcombed and pinned to carry the weight of a sirbandi or a heavy dupatta. We bring fresh flowers if you want them.

items.title: Make-up
items.text: HD base, eyes, lashes and a lip that survives the sindoor. Everything is matched to your trial photographs.

items.title: Sari, jewellery and the last look
items.text: We drape the sari, set the jewellery and the pote, and stay until the car leaves. The touch-up kit goes with your sister.

props.heading: Bridal packages
props.intro: Each includes a trial two to six weeks before. Travel inside the valley is included; outside it, we charge the bus or flight at cost.

props.intro: Five of us, all trained and certified. You can ask for anyone by name.

people.name: Rojina Shakya
people.bio: Fourteen years in colour. Balayage, grey blending and fixing box dye.

people.name: Sabina Tamang
people.bio: Precision bobs, layers and men’s cuts. Takes the Saturday walk-ins.

people.name: Anita Maharjan
people.bio: Brides, sisters and mothers. Weddings across the valley and in Pokhara.

people.name: Pooja Rai
people.bio: Facials, peels, waxing and threading. Asks about your skin before she touches it.

people.name: Kusum Lama
people.bio: Gel, extensions, nail art and lash sets. Books up first before Tihar.

items.a: For threading, blow-dries and men’s cuts, usually yes. For colour, facials and anything longer than an hour, please book so the room is ready.

items.q: I have henna in my hair. Can you still colour it?
items.a: Often, yes, but we do a strand test first. Henna reacts with some lighteners, so we would rather find out on one strand than on your whole head.
The upstairs room is for women only, all day. Waxing and facials are always done there.
Cash, card, eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay QR. Bridal packages take a 30% advance to hold the date.
Call us. Up to fifteen minutes we keep your slot; after that we fit you in where we can or move you to the next free time.

props.title: Bridal make-up, hair and mehndi, from the trial to the bidai
props.text: Anita and her team dress brides across the valley. You meet her at the trial, and she is the one who comes on the morning.

image.alt: Close-up of bridal make-up with a nose ring and chain

props.eyebrow: Now booking for Mangsir and Magh

props.heading: Why brides book a trial
props.body:
A trial is two hours in the salon, two to six weeks before the wedding. We try your make-up under daylight and flash, pin your hair the way it will carry the dupatta, and photograph everything.

On the morning there are no surprises. We bring the photographs, the same products and a checklist, and we leave you with a touch-up kit for the long day of tika.

props.heading: Packages
props.intro: A 30% advance holds your date. The rest is paid on the day.

props.heading: From first call to the morning

items.title: Tell us the date
items.text: Send the date, the place and the ceremony times. We hold the date for three days while you decide.

items.title: The trial
items.text: Bring your blouse, the jewellery if you have it, and photos of looks you like.

items.title: Mehndi
items.text: At your home or at the salon, usually the evening before.

items.title: The morning
items.text: We arrive with everything and stay until you leave for the ceremony.

items.q: Do you come to the venue or the house?
items.a: Yes, anywhere in the valley at no extra charge. For Pokhara, Chitwan or further, we add travel and a night’s stay at cost.

items.q: Can you do my mother and sisters too?
items.a: Yes. For more than four people we bring a second artist so nobody is rushed.
Everyone does. Waterproof lashes and liner, and your touch-up kit, are for exactly that.
If you cancel more than 30 days before, we return the advance less Rs 2,000 for the trial.
